description: Medical-source or extraction error could preserve an incorrect instruction or corrupt negation while appearing cited
mitigation: Keep quotations review-only where medical; block unsupported fields; seek independent semantic review; no clinical correctness claim
trigger: Any invented or altered critical field or source treated as clinically validated

description: Source revision could leave an acknowledgement or completed-task view falsely current
mitigation: Bind derived state to revisions; invalidate dependencies; preserve historical events; reject stale writes under INV-05 through INV-07
trigger: Changed dependency retains current acknowledgement or stale write succeeds

description: A later upload or acknowledgement could incorrectly resolve conflicting sources
mitigation: Require explicit replacement link; keep conflict state separate; permit clarification not disputed action under INV-03 and INV-08
trigger: Last-upload-wins behavior or acknowledgement clears conflict

description: Claimed novelty overlaps existing sourced discharge education and rehearsal products
mitigation: Use narrow revision-to-rehearsal hypothesis; conduct later direct competitor comparison; avoid first-ever claims
trigger: Close end-to-end competitor found or target adults find no added value

description: Entrant may not satisfy student age geography or guardian conditions
mitigation: Require private human eligibility confirmation and current-rule review before registration; do not store identity documents
trigger: Eligibility cannot be confirmed or a restriction excludes entrant

description: Model access reliability pricing or retention terms may prevent proposed extraction and rehearsal
mitigation: Select only after authorized feasibility work; bound spend; support visible unavailability and labeled replay; never assume free credits
trigger: No usable authorized endpoint or cost/retention terms exceed approved limits

description: Independent annotation or qualified language-review availability may be insufficient
mitigation: Recruit separately with consent; record coverage and disagreements; narrow health-rigor claims if unavailable
trigger: No reviewer at planned checkpoint or review coverage falls below declared protocol

description: Scope expands into OCR general medical advice medication tracking or ornamental UI
mitigation: Enforce FR-04 and non-goals; cut optional features before provenance and revision integrity
trigger: New feature displaces core acceptance work or requires therapeutic inference

description: Real health history contact details or sensitive source text could enter repository logs or model prompts
mitigation: Fictional inputs only; adult consent; minimize and separate contact data; safe logging and deletion; no raw note uploads
trigger: Participant shares health details or sensitive data is captured

description: Conflicting IST and CST wording or code-PDF ambiguity could cause late or incomplete submission
mitigation: Keep internal October 6 target; obtain exact UTC and asset requirements; later test submission mechanism with authorization
trigger: No organizer clarification before submission planning or portal requirements differ

description: Acknowledgement rehearsal or citations may be mistaken for medical approval or competence
mitigation: Separate evidence coordination and rehearsal states; use neutral labels; test interpretation with fictional cases
trigger: Any participant treats blocked detail as permission or acknowledgement as clinical approval

description: PDF layout or missing anchors may silently omit supported content
mitigation: Reject unreliable import; offer pasted text; require per-field anchors; disclose unsupported layouts
trigger: Anchor cannot resolve or extraction silently drops table/negation context

description: Synthetic evaluation labels may leak across families or be mistaken for independent clinical validation
mitigation: Split by family before tuning; isolate locked labels; disclose reviewer provenance and regressions; publish actual denominators
trigger: Template leakage or generator-only gold called independently validated

description: Role-switch simulation cached inference or offline state may be represented as live synchronization
mitigation: Visible simulation/replay/offline labels; require actual two-context and live-run evidence for claims
trigger: Demo narrative implies network/model success without executed evidence

description: Document instructions or markup may trigger unsafe actions or cross-session disclosure
mitigation: Treat source as untrusted data; no document-authorized tools; bound input; safe rendering and server-side isolation
trigger: Prompt injection changes workflow authority or content crosses sessions

description: Reuse licenses or restricted health-page material could invalidate corpus distribution or attribution
mitigation: Author original fiction; do not copy MedlinePlus text into datasets; confirm reuse and AI disclosure with organizer
trigger: Third-party text enters corpus without permission or reuse rule remains unresolved

description: Protected AGENTS.md creation previously blocked pending approval
mitigation: Explicit user authorization received; protected write succeeded; verifier confirms file; retain approval requirement for future protected changes
trigger: A future protected change lacks approval
